settings.description: The secret Telegram sends back with each message, which is how the server knows a message is Telegram's.

why.maxTextLength: The adapter cuts a longer message short and says nothing: 4,096 characters as plain text (TELEGRAM_MESSAGE_LIMIT), 32,768 as a rich message. 4,000 is within both.
why.adapterDefaults: Left to choose (mode auto), the adapter can read messages by long polling instead, which a server that answers requests and stops can't hold open. This channel gives Telegram a webhook, so the adapter is told to expect one.
why.settings: In webhook mode the adapter refuses every request unless a secret token is set (TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_ERROR), and the catalog lists the token as optional. It is any text of your own, given to Telegram in the same call as the address (setWebhook's secret_token: 1 to 256 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and -).
